meta.name: Abhinav Sachdeva
meta.availability: Actively seeking Software Engineer / ML-AI Engineer roles
meta.summary: Full-stack engineer and AI researcher with hands-on experience building production web applications and deep learning models. M.S. Computer Science & Engineering from Penn State (GPA 3.77). Skilled across Python, TypeScript, Java, React, and cloud platforms. Built and shipped a Chrome extension with 100+ beta users, co-built an open-source SDK with 1k+ monthly npm downloads, and contributed to AI research on human biomechanics.

experience.title: AI Research Assistant
experience.org: Laboratory for Perception, Action, & Cognition — Penn State
highlights: Researched and designed an LLM (transformer) based AI model in Python & PyTorch to learn connections between images, body poses and foot pressure, predicting foot pressure from partial data with a relative error of 5%.
Built a 3-stage data pre-processing pipeline using NumPy, Python, and PyTorch to transform raw 1.5 TB+ data ready for model training.

Engineered a memory-efficient data loading system using Python multiprocessing and PyTorch DataLoaders to handle 1.5 TB+ of data within 200 GB RAM constraints using lazy loading and parallel processing.
Developed a custom AI model using Variational Autoencoder (VAE) in PyTorch to compress, encode and reconstruct foot pressure maps with 99.9% reconstruction accuracy.
Improved an AI application using Python and Streamlit to generate 3D body models (SMPL) using custom data input.
Trained and validated deep learning models on a remote Linux server via SSH using Anaconda and tmux for persistent, isolated environments.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant
highlights: Performed code reviews for MATLAB & Python code submissions to provide feedback for 200+ undergraduate and graduate computer science students.
Prepared 100+ coding exercises for a Python-based Object Oriented Programming course.

experience.title: Full-Stack Intern
highlights: Architected a full-stack Job Portal website with a secure RESTful backend and a responsive frontend using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, & CSS.
Backend built with REST APIs, JWT authentication, and PostgreSQL for data persistence, deployed on AWS.
Established a CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins and Docker to automate deployment to AWS, with Kubernetes for container orchestration.

java: Built the RESTful backend using Java & Spring Boot with Hibernate/JPA as the ORM on a PostgreSQL database hosted on AWS.
python: Built the RESTful backend using Python & FastAPI with SQLAlchemy as the ORM on a PostgreSQL database hosted on AWS.
nodejs: Built the RESTful backend using TypeScript, Node.js & Express.js with Prisma as the ORM on a PostgreSQL database hosted on AWS.

experience.title: Intern
highlights: Engineered a responsive donor-facing frontend using HTML, JavaScript, & CSS.
Integrated Stripe API to enable seamless donations, raising $1,000 for the cause.
Leveraged Docker to containerize the website and deployed on Azure.

projects.name: Job Assist
projects.description: Full-stack Chrome extension built for a job placement agency, deployed as an exclusive tool for their clients — delivered enough value that the agency raised their service prices.
highlights_common: Partnered with a job placement agency to deploy as an exclusive tool for their clients.
RESTful backend serving 100+ beta users with JWT authentication and PostgreSQL.
Integrated Gmail API with OAuth 2.0, enabling a 1-click email feature that generated 3,000+ outreach email drafts.
Interactive responsive frontend using TypeScript, CSS, & HTML.
Containerized the backend using Docker and deployed on AWS EC2.

java: Backend built using Java, Spring Boot & Hibernate/JPA with PostgreSQL.
python: Backend built using Python, FastAPI & SQLAlchemy with PostgreSQL.
nodejs: Backend built using TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js & Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL.

projects.name: SHM Dashboard
projects.description: Full-stack Structural Health Monitoring dashboard with a RESTful backend, real-time sensor readings, and historical data views.
highlights_common: Engineered a client-facing UI with real-time sensor readings & historical data views using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, & CSS.
Leveraged AWS to host a PostgreSQL database, containerized with Docker and CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
Integrated Thingspeak API so admins can pull all sensor feeds from one account instead of managing separate logins per client.
Eliminated per-client Thingspeak license purchases, generating shareable client links without exposing credentials.

java: Backend built using Java & Spring Boot with Hibernate/JPA as the ORM.
python: Backend built using Python & FastAPI with SQLAlchemy as the ORM.
nodejs: Backend built using TypeScript, Node.js & Express.js with Prisma ORM.

projects.name: Spotified
projects.description: Open-source Spotify Web API SDK for Browser and Node environments with 1,000+ monthly npm downloads.
highlights: Built Spotified, an open-source Spotify Web API SDK using TypeScript & Node.js — 100+ GitHub stars, 1,000+ monthly npm downloads, chosen over Spotify's official SDK.
Implemented authorization flows including Implicit Grant & Auth Code not supported by the official SDK, expanding use cases.
Employed GitHub Actions for CI/CD and delivered 98% test coverage with unit tests written using Jest.
Gained organic adoption with 100+ developers choosing it over Spotify's official SDK.

projects.name: F1 Fantasy Team
projects.description: Full-stack F1 fantasy application that calculates point allocation from race results.
highlights: Developed a secure backend leveraging Java & Spring Boot for point allocation logic.
Engineered a dynamic responsive frontend with React.js, TypeScript, HTML, & CSS.
Managed a PostgreSQL database using Hibernate/JPA hosted on AWS RDS.
Established an automated CI/CD pipeline with Jenkins, containerized with Docker, deployed on AWS EC2.

projects.name: OS Kernel & Security Research
projects.description: Systems programming and security research project covering memory management, kernel development, and exploit research.
highlights: Engineered a custom Dynamic Memory Allocator (malloc) in C, implementing explicit free list and coalescing algorithms to optimize memory throughput & fragmentation.
Implemented 4-level page tables in a custom 64-bit kernel to enforce kernel & user space isolation.
Researched vulnerabilities in the stack frame using GDB and executed buffer overflow attacks using C++ to design custom payloads.

projects.name: Encrypted File System
projects.description: Block-based encrypted file storage engine built in Java as a computer security course project.
highlights: Engineered a block-based file storage engine using Java and AES (CTR mode) to securely store files.
Implemented secure access using SHA-512 password hashing and salt insertion.
Designed tamper-proof file blocks using SHA-based signature systems.
Validated read, write, and edit features through JUnit5.

projects.name: Image Caption Generator
projects.description: Generative AI model to caption images, based on the 'Show, Attend and Tell' paper.
highlights: Implemented an attention-based image captioning model leveraging TensorFlow and Keras.
Experimented with different CNN architectures as image feature extractors, achieving a 1.87% BLEU score improvement after 20 epochs on 30k images.
Deployed the model on GCP Vertex AI using Custom Prediction Route for data pre-processing.
Trained on multiple GPUs on the NCSA cluster for training speedup benchmarking.

projects.name: Nano-GPT
projects.description: GPT model trained and fine-tuned on Robert Frost's poetry.
highlights: Trained and fine-tuned a GPT model on 5,500 lines of Robert Frost's poetry to generate stylistically coherent text.
Built using PyTorch and Jupyter Notebook.

projects.name: Movie Recommendation Engine
projects.description: ML-powered movie recommendation system using collaborative filtering.
highlights: Built using collaborative filtering (matrix factorization), trained on 32M user ratings from the MovieLens dataset.
Deployed via Flask for scalable API access, demonstrating end-to-end ML systems design and large-scale data mining.

projects.name: Tab Group Wizard
projects.description: Chrome extension to organize browser tabs into groups via right-click.
highlights: Built a Chrome Extension enabling users to group links into tab groups via right-click, cutting steps from 5 to 2 and eliminating manual tab dragging.
Applied core UI/UX principles with dynamic context menus, debounced UI updates, and error handling.
Published on the Chrome Web Store.

projects.name: SpeedSense
projects.description: watchOS app to estimate ball throw speed and spin using inertial sensor data.
highlights: Developed a watchOS app to estimate ball throw speed and spin using inertial sensor data.
Implemented a speed estimation algorithm with a median error of 1.4 m/s.
Designed a pipeline with server-side processing using Flask and SciPy, and real-time visualization with Chart.js.
